finalText:
Green. 625/625.

Only real bug: `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js:39` taxed pre-discount base.

```js
const discounted = applyDiscount(cents, discountPct);
const tax = roundCents(cents * taxRate);   // cents, not discounted
return discounted + tax;
```

Own doc comment said tax discounted amount. 3 of 625 cases caught it — rest had discount OR tax zero, so wrong base invisible. Fix:

```js
return roundCents(discounted * (1 + taxRate));
```

Rest of engine correct.
